purpose: Defines the items, purposes, and writing guidelines that the application overview requirements document (APP-001) must contain, applicable to any project type.
summary: Positions APP-001 as the project compass answering why, what, for whom, how used, and how to verify
Lists 17 items from overview, background, and problems to terms and related documents
Each item has a purpose, writing guideline, and required or recommended level
Covers goals with FNC traceability and verifiable success criteria
Requires scope to state both in-scope and explicitly out-of-scope items
Covers target users, supported platforms, prerequisites, and environment composition
Covers usage scenarios and the feature index pointing to FNC documents
Covers external dependencies, constraints, and known risks with impact levels
Notes to write What not How, use the user manual test, and keep no change history
tasks: Writing an application overview requirements document (APP-001)
Reviewing APP-001 for missing or weak items
Deciding whether content belongs in APP-001 or a design document
Defining project scope and out-of-scope items
Writing success criteria and risks for a project
Creating requirements for a new project from scratch
title: APP概要要件定義書 記載基準
